Also independently inspected timed clock regions for all ten IDs and verified each corrected worker/wrapper boundary against its exact file. Other nine full source/arithmetic inspections are Luna's with primary claims and provenance checks.
corrections: Versions1/2 misidentified some direct-main GOMP calls as wrapper calls and supplied incomplete or copied function ranges. Version3 fixes exact timed call chains and exact per-file worker/wrapper boundaries; independent sample has worker882-1033 and wrapper1200-1258. No finding changed.
